description: Dawood Equities Limited was incorporated under the Companies Ordinance 1984 on 3 May 2006 and commenced commercial operations on 3 October 2006. It is registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan as a broker and is a corporate member of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, undertaking the sale and purchase of listed securities. Alongside equity brokerage it underwrites initial public offerings, acts as custodian of client securities, and provides research reports.
headOffice: 17th Floor, Saima Trade Tower-A, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
